name: console.log of a caught Error starts with name and message
source:
import { inspect } from 'node:util'; function main(): void {   try { throw new TypeError('msg'); } catch (e) { console.log(inspect(e).split('
')[0]); console.log(String((e as Error).stack).split('
')[0]); }   try { throw new Error('boom'); } catch (err) { console.log(String((err as Error).stack).split('
')[0]); } }
